new.s: Which one of the following correctly relates Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) to Gross Value Added (GVA)?
o: GSDP = GVA + product taxes - product subsidies
GSDP = GVA - product taxes + product subsidies
new.x: GSDP is GVA plus product taxes minus product subsidies. Subtracting taxes and adding subsidies reverses the adjustment. Depreciation is not part of the GVA-to-GSDP step: taking it out gives a net measure (NSDP), which is what per capita income is computed on.
new.tq: GVA + product taxes - product subsidies = GSDP; PCI is on NSDP.

new.s: The per capita income of an economy rises only when:
o: national income grows faster than population
population grows faster than national income
depreciation grows faster than gross output
new.x: PCI is income divided by population, so it rises only when income grows faster than population. If population grows faster, PCI falls. Rising prices raise only nominal income, not real PCI. Faster-growing depreciation reduces the net product and so pulls PCI down.
new.tq: PCI up only if income growth > population growth.
